messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: sudden per-model TPM spike detected for model family aurora14b in us-west-2. 5min avg TPM = 1820 (baseline 420). Errors rising: 5xx spike + 429s. Auto-sculpt didn't trigger due to mixed-tag routing.

jordan_oncall: got it, paging in. I'm oncall for eng-oncall. Taking lead.

sam_sre: pinging infra to confirm quota knobs. can we do a temporary TPM/RPM carve?

jordan_oncall: yes. initial mitigation plan: 1) lower aurora14b TPM to 300, RPM to 900 2) enable fallback routing to aurora14b-quantized-v2 3) disable long-context mode for aurora14b for 10m 4) notify support + customers. any objections?

maya_support: heads-up — Support queue shows ~12 customers hitting 429s, mostly interactive chat apps. ETA for mitigation?

li_engineer: I'll prepare the quota change. Command below (internal CLI):

```
quotactl set --model aurora14b --region us-west-2 --tpm 300 --rpm 900 --reason "active surge - temporary sculpt"
```

li_engineer: also can enable fallback routing:

```
routingctl route-add --from aurora14b --to aurora14b-quantized-v2 --pct 30 --policy graceful
```

jordan_oncall: execute both. li, please run now and paste outputs here.

ops-bot: running apply: quotactl...

ops-bot: quotactl result: OK. aurora14b TPM set 300 RPM set 900 (applied by li_engineer). change_id: cq-2026-0401-78

ops-bot: routingctl result: OK. 30% traffic routed to aurora14b-quantized-v2 (applied by li_engineer). change_id: rc-2026-0401-79

jordan_oncall: confirm metrics — 1min after change: TPM 440 -> 380; 5xx and 429 trending down. keeping sculpt for 15m and watching.

sam_sre: can we also disable long-context token-sidecar to reduce tails? small config flip: `featureflag disable aurora14b.long_context`

li_engineer: disabled long_context in us-west-2 for aurora14b. ops-bot responded OK.

maya_support: noting in status page draft: "We are throttling a specific model family to maintain platform availability. Some customers using aurora14b may see rate limit errors or slower responses; alternatives available." will post in 5 if no objections.

paula_prod: customer escalation — Cust-3921 (chat platform) reports degraded UX. They've been contacted by AE and prefer a fast rollback if this causes sustained failures for them. Do we have per-customer carveouts?

jordan_oncall: we can do targeted carveouts if it's a priority. For now, monitor 10m window; if errors drop to baseline, we'll gradually relax throttles. If Cust-3921 needs relief, we can raise their per-API-key TPM temporarily. li, what's the command for per-key override?

li_engineer: per-key override: `quotactl set --apikey <key> --tpm 1200 --scope temporary --expire 30m` — need PM/CS approval.

maya_support: we've requested approval from AE, should have go/no-go in ~8m.

jordan_oncall: timeline: 15m watch window. If metrics stable, increment TPM to 600 and pct fallback to 20. If relapse, escalate to SRE lead and consider region-wide carving.

sam_sre: logging plan in incident ticket IT-3481. Documenting commands, change_ids: cq-2026-0401-78, rc-2026-0401-79. Putting next oncall handoff to @sam_sre in 20m for continued monitoring.

jordan_oncall: handoff note: will leave the thread to sam in 20m. Key points: temporary per-model throttle applied, fallback routing enabled, long-context disabled, support Slack status drafted, potential per-customer carveouts available.

ops-bot: metrics update (5m later): aurora14b 5min TPM=320, 5xx errors down 74%, 429s down 60%.

paula_prod: thanks team. AE approved per-key relief for Cust-3921, ops team please apply per-key override when ready.

li_engineer: applied per-key override for Cust-3921 (key masked). change_id: cq-2026-0401-80. Confirmed they see reduced 429s.

sam_sre: taking over monitoring. I'll keep sculpt in place for at least another 30m and coordinate a gradual lift to avoid oscillation. leaving note for post-incident follow-up: evaluate why auto-sculpt didn't trigger and whether mixed-tag routing prevented it.

jordan_oncall: thanks all. I'll update the incident ticket and add retrospective items. moving to handoff. :thumbsup:
